sections.heading: Sharing a quantity in a given ratio

questions.q: Share $150$ in the ratio $2:3$.
Share $220$ among three people in the ratio $3:4:4$.
A prize of 900 riyals is shared between Sara and Layla in the ratio $5:4$. Find each share.
questions.answer: $5+4=9$ parts, each part $=900\div9=100$. Sara receives $500$ riyals; Layla receives $400$ riyals.

questions.q: Divide 84 kg of flour in the ratio $1:2:4$.
questions.answer: $1+2+4=7$ parts, each part $=84\div7=12$ kg. Shares: $12$ kg, $24$ kg, $48$ kg.

sections.heading: Finding percentage change and original values

questions.q: A price rises from $80$ to $92$. Find the percentage increase.
A quantity falls from $250$ to $200$. Find the percentage decrease.
After a $20\%$ discount, a jacket costs 96 riyals. Find the original price.
After a $15\%$ increase, a value becomes $138$. Find the original value.
A price of $100$ rises $10\%$, then falls $10\%$. Find the final price.
questions.answer: $100\times1.1\times0.9=99$ — one riyal less than the start, since the second change applies to a larger base.

questions.q: A stock worth 200 riyals rises $20\%$ one year, then rises a further $25\%$ the next year. Find the final value.
A quantity decreases by $10\%$, then decreases by a further $10\%$. Find the overall percentage decrease from the original amount.
questions.answer: $100\times0.9\times0.9=81$, a fall of $19$ from $100$ — an overall decrease of $19\%$ (not $20\%$).

questions.q: A price of 400 riyals increases by $5\%$, then decreases by $5\%$. Find the final price, and state whether it equals the starting price.
questions.answer: $400\times1.05\times0.95=399$ riyals — one riyal less than the original 400, so it is not equal.

questions.q: $y$ is directly proportional to $x$, and $y=15$ when $x=3$. Find $y$ when $x=8$.
4 kg of apples cost 28 riyals. Find the cost of 7 kg at the same rate.
questions.answer: Cost per kg $=28\div4=7$ riyals. Cost of $7$ kg $=7\times7=49$ riyals.

questions.q: A car uses 8 liters of fuel to travel 96 km. How far can it travel on 20 liters at the same rate?
questions.answer: Rate $=96\div8=12$ km per liter. Distance $=20\times12=240$ km.

questions.q: 6 identical pens cost 27 riyals. Find the cost of 10 pens.
questions.answer: Cost per pen $=27\div6=4.5$ riyals. Cost of $10$ pens $=10\times4.5=45$ riyals.

questions.q: 4 workers can complete a job in 15 days. How many days would 6 workers take, working at the same rate?
questions.answer: Total work $=4\times15=60$ worker-days. With $6$ workers: $60\div6=10$ days.

questions.q: A car covers a fixed distance in 5 hours at 60 km/h. How long would the same trip take at 75 km/h?
questions.answer: Distance $=60\times5=300$ km. Time at $75$ km/h: $300\div75=4$ hours.

questions.q: 8 taps fill a pool in 12 hours. How long would 3 taps take, running at the same rate?
questions.answer: Total work $=8\times12=96$ tap-hours. With $3$ taps: $96\div3=32$ hours.

sections.heading: Best value and unit price comparisons

questions.q: A 3 kg bag of rice costs 27 riyals, and a 5 kg bag costs 42.50 riyals. Which is the better value per kilogram?
questions.answer: 3 kg bag: $27\div3=9$ riyals/kg. 5 kg bag: $42.5\div5=8.5$ riyals/kg. The 5 kg bag is better value.

questions.q: Store A sells 6 pens for 15 riyals; Store B sells 8 pens for 19.20 riyals. Which store offers the lower price per pen?
questions.answer: Store A: $15\div6=2.5$ riyals/pen. Store B: $19.2\div8=2.4$ riyals/pen. Store B has the lower price per pen.

questions.q: A 2-liter bottle of juice costs 14 riyals. Find the price per 100 mL.
questions.answer: $2$ liters $=20$ portions of $100$ mL, so price per $100$ mL $=14\div20=0.7$ riyals.

questions.q: Which is the better deal: 12 eggs for 9 riyals, or 18 eggs for 12.60 riyals?
questions.answer: 12 eggs: $9\div12=0.75$ riyals/egg. 18 eggs: $12.6\div18=0.70$ riyals/egg. The 18-egg pack is the better deal.

questions.q: A recipe requires flour and sugar in the ratio $5:2$. If 350 g of flour is used, how much sugar is needed?
A shop raises the price of a shirt from 60 to 75 riyals, then during a sale reduces the new price by $20\%$. Find the sale price.
questions.answer: New price after the sale: $75\times0.8=60$ riyals — back to the original price.

questions.q: In a class of 40 students, $60\%$ are girls. Then 4 more girls join the class. What percent of the class is now girls, to the nearest percent?
questions.answer: Girls initially $=0.6\times40=24$; boys $=16$. After $4$ more girls: $28$ girls out of $44$ students. $\dfrac{28}{44}\times100\%\approx64\%$.
